title: Round 1 sealed investigation:  universal transformations of ECDLP instances
question: Can an arbitrary ECDLP instance (E/F_q, P, Q=[k]P) be transformed, in time polynomial (ideally quasi-linear) in input length, into an equivalent instance of a problem with additional exploitable structure, with efficient solution recovery? Characterize the requirements on such a transformation and explain precisely why known restricted-case transfers (MOV/FR pairings, anomalous/SSSA lifts, GHS Weil descent, summation-polynomial index calculus, isogeny walks) do not generalize.
